data.standardized_narrative: The syndicate experienced a gross strengthening of GBP 5.129 million in prior year reserves, primarily due to adverse claims development and IBNR recalibration. This represents an 8.25% increase from the opening reserves of GBP 62.137 million. Specific prior year movements include a release of GBP 1.1 million from Hurricane Matthew claims in 2016. The run-off years (2012, 2013, 2014) showed cumulative closing losses of GBP 21.6m, GBP 8.4m, and GBP 12.6m respectively, with movements in CY 2017 being losses of GBP 4.4m, GBP 2.2m, and GBP 1.3m. The 2015 year of account had a cumulative closing loss of GBP 4.0m, with a profit of GBP 0.2m movement in CY 2017. For the 2017 year, significant events included net losses of GBP 14.6 million from Hurricanes Harvey, Irma, and Maria, and GBP 1.5 million from the Mexico earthquake. The 2016 year of account also had net losses of GBP 2.4 million from HIM losses and GBP 1.8 million from Peruvian floods.
